name: A difficult debut
text: The ambition is visible, but the scattered storytelling struggles to connect.

name: Flashes of promise
text: A few memorable scenes shine through an uneven film. There is a voice worth watching.

name: An assured storyteller
text: Confident performances and a focused script make this a rewarding evening at the cinema.

name: A film that stays with you
text: A vivid, emotionally precise film. The images linger long after the lights come up.
